RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current rate-limit window (10 standard or 60 premium).

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

Forbidden.description: API access is disabled under the Acceptable Use Policy.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Check the rate-limit headers before retrying.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing or invalid.

hasMore.description: Whether another page of results is available.

limit.description: Maximum startups returned on this page (up to 10).

last30Days.description: Verified revenue over the last 30 days, in USD cents.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue, in USD cents.

total.description: Total available revenue, in USD cents.

allOf.description: Additional fields returned by the detail endpoint.

description.description: Full startup description; unlike list results, it is not truncated.

domainRating.description: Ahrefs Domain Rating on a 0-100 scale, when available.

founderMessage.description: Founder-provided message; returned when the startup is on sale.

isMerchantOfRecord.description: Whether the startup uses a merchant of record.

marketingChannels.description: Marketing channels used to acquire customers.

startupInsights.description: Public founder-edited startup insights when available.

StartupSummary.description: Startup fields returned by the list endpoint.

askingPrice.description: Asking price, when listed for sale, in USD cents.

description.description: Description truncated to 200 characters in list results.

firstListedForSaleAt.description: Timestamp when the startup was first listed for sale.

foundedDate.description: Founding date; the API example represents this as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

googleSearchImpressionsLast30Days.description: Google search result impressions over the last 30 days, when Search Console is connected.

growth30d.description: Revenue growth over the last 30 days. TrustMRR's guide describes examples such as 24 meaning 24%, while its example payload uses 0.12; the documented scale is inconsistent.

growthMRR30d.description: MRR growth over the last 30 days, as a percentage.

icon.description: URL to the startup icon or logo.

multiple.description: Asking price divided by annualized revenue.

onSale.description: Whether the startup is currently listed for sale.

paymentProvider.description: Payment provider used for revenue verification.

profitMarginLast30Days.description: Profit margin over the last 30 days, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

rank.description: Hourly updated revenue rank among active startups; 1 is highest.

revenuePerVisitor.description: Last-30-days revenue divided by last-30-days visitors.

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier for the detail endpoint.

visitorsLast30Days.description: Total website visitors over the last 30 days.

xHandle.description: Founder's X handle without the @ symbol.

TrustMRRBearer.description: Create an API key in the TrustMRR developer dashboard.

info.description:
OpenAPI description of the documented TrustMRR v1 read API. Revenue and
asking-price amounts are USD cents. Requests require a TrustMRR API key.

TrustMRR's API Acceptable Use Policy prohibits bulk export and systematic
reconstruction of its database; public display, republication, or AI use
may require prior written permission. The API guide includes an example
that iterates through all pages, but that example does not override the
current Terms of Service.
info.title: TrustMRR API
